name: get_alias
description:
Retrieves an Alias for the given host name or alias ID.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v4/aliases/{idOrAlias} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

from.description: Get the alias only if it was created after the provided timestamp

idOrAlias.description: The alias or alias ID to be retrieved

projectId.description: Get the alias only if it is assigned to the provided project ID

since.description: Get the alias only if it was created after this JavaScript timestamp

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Get the alias only if it was created before this JavaScript timestamp
